title: Test more features from our upcoming drop
translated_title: 测试我们即将发布的更新中包含的更多功能
author: Cristina Anderca
imageAltText: A colorful house and white tent sit among towering bamboo in a Minecraft jungle, with players exploring and lanterns lighting the camp.
description: Starting this week, testing players can discover maps in abandoned camps and build with concrete slabs and stairs. Both features are out now in Java snapshot and coming very soon to Bedrock beta & preview.

blocks.source_text: Like many brave* pioneers from the Minecraft community, I’ve been spending the last few weeks exploring the dappled forest and searching for abandoned camps. But testing features is serious work! If only I had a place to rest...
blocks.translated_text: 和Minecraft社区中的许多勇敢的先驱一样，过去几周我一直在斑驳的森林中探索，寻找废弃的营地。不过测试新功能是一项严肃的工作！要是我能有個地方休息多好……

blocks.source_text: Good thing I’ve already crafted a cushion that I can sit on while I tell you about this week’s testing release, which brings the final features from our third drop! Plus, we’ll recap all the features that have come out so far, from the majestic dappled forest to the humble (but so handy) straw bed.
blocks.translated_text: 幸好我已经制作了一个靠垫，可以坐在上面给你们介绍这周的测试版本。这次测试版本带来了我们第三次更新中的最后几项功能！此外，我们还会回顾到目前为止推出的所有功能，从雄伟的斑驳森林到实用又简约的稻草床。

blocks.source_text: Starting this week, testing players can discover maps in abandoned camps and build with concrete slabs and stairs. Both features are out now in Java snapshot and coming very soon to Bedrock beta & preview.
blocks.translated_text: 从本周开始，参与测试的玩家可以在废弃的营地里发现地图，并使用混凝土板和中楼梯进行建造。这两个功能已经在Java版本的快照中上线了，很快也会在Bedrock版的测试版和预览版中推出。

blocks.source_text: Maps in abandoned camps
blocks.translated_text: 废弃营地中的地图

blocks.source_text: As if abandoned camps weren’t mysterious enough, now some of them contain maps hidden inside their chests! These maps lead to other abandoned camps or various other types of structures in the Overworld. The only way to find out exactly where is to just head there! Wait, did you hear that? I think that’s the sound of adventure calling...
blocks.translated_text: 仿佛废弃的营地还不够神秘似的，现在有些营地里的箱子里还藏着地图！这些地图会通向其他废弃的营地或是《我的世界》中的各种建筑。唯一能确定地图位置的方法就是亲自去那里看看！等等，你听到吗？我觉得那声音是冒险在召唤你……

blocks.source_text: Concrete slabs & stairs
blocks.translated_text: 混凝土板和楼梯

meta.alt: A colorful Minecraft house built from pink, blue, yellow, and orange blocks sits in a forest clearing as players gather around its lantern-lit entrance.

blocks.source_text: Builders can now make more with concrete! Now you can build with concrete stairs and slabs in all 16 colors – simply combine a dye of your choice with sand and gravel to get your desired hue of concrete dust, place it in water to make a concrete block and then craft your concrete blocks into stairs or slabs. Or you can just grab it from the Creative inventory – I won’t tell.
blocks.translated_text: 建造者现在可以使用混凝土来建造更多东西了！你可以用16种颜色中的任何一种来制作混凝土楼梯和板：只需将你选择的染料与沙子和砂石混合，制成所需的混凝土粉末，然后将其放入水中生成混凝土块，再将这些混凝土块制作成楼梯或板。当然，你也可以直接从创造模式背包中获取它们——我就不多说了。

blocks.source_text: A recap of the features released so far
blocks.translated_text: 迄今为止发布的功能概述

blocks.source_text: In case you missed it, two weeks ago we released the first set of features from this drop! These include:
blocks.translated_text: 如果你错过了的话，两周前我们发布了这次更新的第一批功能！其中包括：

blocks.source_text: Cushions
blocks.translated_text: 靠垫

blocks.source_text: Finally, a place to just sit down and take a breath! Or tell a story. Or enjoy a meal. Or just stare at a campfire. Cushions can be found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 wool slabs of the same color. Cushions are a game changer when it comes to decorating your base or creating more lifelike builds. Now you can have the sectional of your dreams or a more realistic stadium! The sky Y = 320 is the limit.
blocks.translated_text: 终于，有了一个可以坐下来休息、讲故事、享用美食或者只是凝视篝火的地方了！靠垫可以在废弃的营地找到，或者用3块相同颜色的羊毛板制作。在装饰你的基地或创造更逼真的建筑时，靠垫真的改变了游戏体验。现在你可以打造出梦寐以求的沙发组合，或者一个更真实的体育场了！天空的高度上限是320单位。

blocks.source_text: Straw beds
blocks.translated_text: 草床

blocks.source_text: Found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 hay bales, straw beds are the easiest way to sleep through the night, oblivious to its horrors. Just remember that they are consumable, and they won’t reset your spawn point! As my back can attest to, cheap comfort has its tradeoffs, but there’s no feeling it like roughing it in nature.
blocks.translated_text: 草床可以在废弃的营地找到，或者用3捆干草制作。草床是最方便的睡觉方式，可以让你在夜晚安然入睡，忘却外界的危险。不过请记住，它们是可消耗的，并且不会重置你的出生点！以我的经验来说，虽然便宜的舒适度有其代价，但在大自然中体验艰苦生活的感觉也是独一无二的。

blocks.source_text: The dappled forest
blocks.translated_text: 斑驳的森林

blocks.source_text: This welcoming, warm-toned biome is equally inviting and intriguing. Walk amongst the poplar trees and red shrubs, and who knows what you might stumble upon. Is that a tent?... Wonder who left that here.
blocks.translated_text: 这个氛围温馨、色调明亮的生物群系既诱人又充满神秘感。漫步在杨树和红色灌木丛之间，谁知道你会发现什么呢？那是一个帐篷吗？…… wonder who left that here.

blocks.source_text: The abandoned camp
blocks.translated_text: 废弃的营地

blocks.source_text: This mysterious structure can appear in any biome. An empty tent, a campfire, a straw bed, a cushion... and some loot? Who built this and where have they gone? Light a fire, take a seat, and ponder that as the sun sets. It may be abandoned, but it’s a precious shelter.
blocks.translated_text: 这个神秘的建筑可以出现在任何生物群系中：一个空荡荡的帐篷、一堆篝火、一张草垫、一个靠垫……还有一些战利品？谁建造了它，他们又去了哪里？生一堆火，坐下来静静思考吧，当太阳落山的时候。虽然这个地方已经被废弃，但它仍是一个宝贵的避难所。

blocks.source_text: Wool slabs and stairs
blocks.translated_text: 羊毛块和台阶

blocks.source_text: Our woolliest block set has two soft additions: stairs and slabs! Craft them in any of the 16 colors to add smoother shapes, layered textures, and creative details to everything from custom furniture to cozy hideouts ready for crisp nights in the wilderness.
blocks.translated_text: 我们最柔软的羊毛材质现在新增了两种建筑材料：台阶和羊毛块！你可以用16种颜色中的任何一种来制作它们，为定制家具或舒适的藏身处增添更流畅的造型、分层的纹理以及富有创意的细节，让你在荒野中度过美好的夜晚。

blocks.source_text: Poplar trees, red shrub, and shelf mushroom
blocks.translated_text: 杨树、红色灌木和架子蘑菇

blocks.source_text: The dappled forest is rich in color palette and flora, thanks to the various plants and fungi found there. Enjoy the rich tones of the poplar tree’s foliage, then chop one down to get poplar wood, which can be crafted into a full set. Grab a red shrub and bring it home for a pop of color in your base. The versatile shelf mushrooms grow on poplar trees – jump on them, cook with them, or feed them bonemeal and watch them grow.
blocks.translated_text: 这片斑驳的森林色彩丰富，植物和真菌种类繁多。欣赏杨树叶子美丽的色彩吧，然后砍下一棵杨树以获取杨木，这些杨木可以用来制作完整的工具套装。拿上一株红色灌木，把它带回基地，为你的基地增添一抹色彩。架子蘑菇生长在杨树上——你可以踩在它们上面、用它们做饭，或者给它们喂骨粉，观察它们是如何生长的。

blocks.source_text: So pack your scout’s supplies and venture out! Your most rugged adventure yet awaits in Java snapshot and Bedrock beta & preview.
blocks.translated_text: 那就收拾好你的探险装备，出发吧！Java 版本的快照以及 Bedrock 测试版和预览版正等着你经历最惊险的冒险呢！

blocks.source_text: How can I test these features?
blocks.translated_text: 我该如何测试这些新功能呢？

blocks.source_text: You can test these features by enabling snapshots for Minecraft: Java Edition, or by enabling previews/beta** for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition. To install a snapshot, open up the Minecraft Launcher and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab. To turn on an experiment in preview/beta for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition [follow these instructions](https://www.minecraft.net/article/how-get-minecraft-betas).
blocks.translated_text: 您可以通过为 Java 版 Minecraft 启用快照功能，或为基岩版 Minecraft 启用预览/测试版功能来测试这些新特性。要安装快照，请打开 Minecraft 启动器，并在“安装”选项卡中启用快照功能。要为基岩版 Minecraft 启用预览/测试版功能，请[按照这些说明操作](https://www.minecraft.net/article/how-get-minecraft-betas)。

blocks.source_text: Send us your feedback!
blocks.translated_text: 请向我们发送您的反馈意见！

blocks.source_text: These features are all still in development, which means that the details outlined above might change as we iterate on them. So then why have we released them into testing? Because we want your feedback! [Send us your thoughts](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/community/topics/46325722710285) and report bugs at [bugs.mojang.com](https://bugs.mojang.com/)!
blocks.translated_text: 这些特性仍在开发中，这意味着上面的详细信息可能会在迭代过程中发生变化。那么为什么我们要将它们发布到测试阶段呢？因为我们希望听到您的反馈！[请将您的想法发送给我们](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/community/topics/46325722710285)，并在[bugs.mojang.com](https://bugs.mojang.com/)上报告bug。

blocks.source_text: *Editor’s note: Any claims made by the author about their own bravery, daring, grit, or other similar qualities are purely deluded subjective and do not represent the collective opinion of Minecraft.net’s editorial team.
blocks.translated_text: *编者注：作者关于自己勇敢、大胆、坚韧或其他类似品质的说法纯属主观幻想，并不代表 Minecraft.net 编辑部的集体观点。

blocks.source_text: **New features are coming in the future and will require Minecraft Bedrock Edition or Java Edition (each sold separately). As development is ongoing, the features shown and their descriptions are subject to change. Feedback from the community will help us iterate these features into their final versions.
blocks.translated_text: **未来将会有新功能推出，这些功能需要使用 Minecraft: 基岩版或 Java 版（二者均需单独购买）。由于开发工作仍在进行中，所展示的功能及其描述可能会发生变化。社区的反馈将帮助我们将这些功能完善至最终版本。

content:
Like many brave* pioneers from the Minecraft community, I’ve been spending the last few weeks exploring the dappled forest and searching for abandoned camps. But testing features is serious work! If only I had a place to rest...

Good thing I’ve already crafted a cushion that I can sit on while I tell you about this week’s testing release, which brings the final features from our third drop! Plus, we’ll recap all the features that have come out so far, from the majestic dappled forest to the humble (but so handy) straw bed.

Starting this week, testing players can discover maps in abandoned camps and build with concrete slabs and stairs. Both features are out now in Java snapshot and coming very soon to Bedrock beta & preview.

Maps in abandoned camps

As if abandoned camps weren’t mysterious enough, now some of them contain maps hidden inside their chests! These maps lead to other abandoned camps or various other types of structures in the Overworld. The only way to find out exactly where is to just head there! Wait, did you hear that? I think that’s the sound of adventure calling...

Concrete slabs & stairs

[IMAGE:A colorful Minecraft house built from pink, blue, yellow, and orange blocks sits in a forest clearing as players gather around its lantern-lit entrance.](https://www.minecraft.net/content/dam/minecraftnet/games/minecraft/screenshots/MCV_Forest_BPS_July30_Campaign_House_1280x720.jpg)

Builders can now make more with concrete! Now you can build with concrete stairs and slabs in all 16 colors – simply combine a dye of your choice with sand and gravel to get your desired hue of concrete dust, place it in water to make a concrete block and then craft your concrete blocks into stairs or slabs. Or you can just grab it from the Creative inventory – I won’t tell.

A recap of the features released so far

In case you missed it, two weeks ago we released the first set of features from this drop! These include:

Cushions

Finally, a place to just sit down and take a breath! Or tell a story. Or enjoy a meal. Or just stare at a campfire. Cushions can be found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 wool slabs of the same color. Cushions are a game changer when it comes to decorating your base or creating more lifelike builds. Now you can have the sectional of your dreams or a more realistic stadium! The sky Y = 320 is the limit.

Straw beds

Found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 hay bales, straw beds are the easiest way to sleep through the night, oblivious to its horrors. Just remember that they are consumable, and they won’t reset your spawn point! As my back can attest to, cheap comfort has its tradeoffs, but there’s no feeling it like roughing it in nature.

The dappled forest

This welcoming, warm-toned biome is equally inviting and intriguing. Walk amongst the poplar trees and red shrubs, and who knows what you might stumble upon. Is that a tent?... Wonder who left that here.

The abandoned camp

This mysterious structure can appear in any biome. An empty tent, a campfire, a straw bed, a cushion... and some loot? Who built this and where have they gone? Light a fire, take a seat, and ponder that as the sun sets. It may be abandoned, but it’s a precious shelter.

Wool slabs and stairs

Our woolliest block set has two soft additions: stairs and slabs! Craft them in any of the 16 colors to add smoother shapes, layered textures, and creative details to everything from custom furniture to cozy hideouts ready for crisp nights in the wilderness.

Poplar trees, red shrub, and shelf mushroom

The dappled forest is rich in color palette and flora, thanks to the various plants and fungi found there. Enjoy the rich tones of the poplar tree’s foliage, then chop one down to get poplar wood, which can be crafted into a full set. Grab a red shrub and bring it home for a pop of color in your base. The versatile shelf mushrooms grow on poplar trees – jump on them, cook with them, or feed them bonemeal and watch them grow.

So pack your scout’s supplies and venture out! Your most rugged adventure yet awaits in Java snapshot and Bedrock beta & preview.

How can I test these features?

You can test these features by enabling snapshots for Minecraft: Java Edition, or by enabling previews/beta** for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition. To install a snapshot, open up the Minecraft Launcher and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab. To turn on an experiment in preview/beta for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition [follow these instructions](https://www.minecraft.net/article/how-get-minecraft-betas).

Send us your feedback!

These features are all still in development, which means that the details outlined above might change as we iterate on them. So then why have we released them into testing? Because we want your feedback! [Send us your thoughts](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/community/topics/46325722710285) and report bugs at [bugs.mojang.com](https://bugs.mojang.com/)!

*Editor’s note: Any claims made by the author about their own bravery, daring, grit, or other similar qualities are purely deluded subjective and do not represent the collective opinion of Minecraft.net’s editorial team.

**New features are coming in the future and will require Minecraft Bedrock Edition or Java Edition (each sold separately). As development is ongoing, the features shown and their descriptions are subject to change. Feedback from the community will help us iterate these features into their final versions.

我们最柔软的羊毛材质现在新增了两种建筑材料：台阶和羊毛块！你可以用16种颜色中的任何一种来制作它们，为定制家具或舒适的藏身处增添更流畅的造型、分层的纹理以及富有创意的细节，让你在荒野中度过美好的夜晚。
